name: control-plane-shell
description: The control-plane SHELL worker (deploys as "iterate-control-plane") — the outer onion layer a project worker falls back to: platform-secret substitution on egress, capability fallthrough, and outer→inner stream writes via the cross-script STREAM_DO binding. Minimal on purpose: no DOs of its own, no loader. The real identity shell (OAuth AS + D1 directory) is packages/v3/control-plane.
